help.inventory:
• Items carried by mercenaries are not changed or deleted.
  • Quantities go from 1 to 999,999,999. The game may split one row into several slots by its stack limit.
help.repurchase:
• Sell the item to a vendor in the game, save, and open that save.
  • Swap the sold item for another one, save, then buy it back from the same vendor in the game.
help.equipment:
• Enchantment goes up to the item's limit in the game data. Equipment with no stored enchantment value cannot be changed.
  • Sockets open up to the equipment's limit. A slot holding Abyss Gear cannot be locked; choose Clear to remove the gear.
  • Mercenary equipment can be edited too.
help.knowledge:
• Learning adds an entry at level 1. A level change applies to one learned entry.
  • Learn All Knowledge & Apply Maximum Levels covers every entry, whatever the filters show.
  • Right-click a row to copy its key.
help.challenges:
• Complete only the selected checkpoints, or the whole challenge.
  • Rewards, knowledge and items are not given or used up.
  • A challenge that needs a step in the game first, such as using a sealed artifact, is view-only.
help.fishing:
• Catch any one fish in the game and save before editing records. One catch is enough for every kind.
  • A fish whose knowledge is not learned needs it before its size can be recorded.
help.maps:
• Pick a category on the left to list its places on the right.
  • Activate selected categories activates every place of the categories selected on the left. Activate selected places activates only the rows picked on the right.
  • A place's knowledge rises to the level at which the game counts it as found. Nodes, and places whose later levels come from quests, stay at level 1.
  • A bell adds its map record and the Bells knowledge.
  • Rewards and items are not given.
help.companions:
• Only Grey-0 robots and festival recruits can be added or removed, even on a save that has none yet.
  • A new worker joins at the end of the list, hired at the current game time.
  • Pictures appear after syncing game data.
help.pets:
• Rename an entry or clear its name to return to the default. Reset All clears every name in the tab, whatever is selected.
  • Move Up and Move Down change the order in the game. Name, gear and level move with the animal.
  • Only categories in the save get a tab. Characters used for map viewing cannot be edited.
help.npc:
Trust

  • Set 0–100 in steps of 5. Only NPCs with a stored trust value can be edited.
  • Talk to the NPC once in the game so that quests see the new value.

Bond

  • The bond builds after Interact > Seduce, separately for each character. Only a value the game has raised at least once can change, and it cannot go below the current value.
  • The editor changes only the selected character's value; it does not lower the others as the game does.
  • Kliff's romance quests with the four witches move on from the bond itself: talk to her once in the game after the change. Stages already passed do not go back.
help.skills:
• Shows only skills the game teaches by watching: in combat with monsters and bosses, or at a demonstration in a region.
  • An unlearned skill is learned at level 1 with the record the game writes when you watch it, plus what level 1 grants.
  • A skill already learned another way keeps its level and only gains the watch record.
  • Level investments are left to the game.
help.items_db:
• A lookup only; it does not change the save.
  • Copy Key (button or right-click) copies an item key.
help.backup:
• Every save first backs up the previous file.
  • PRISTINE is the copy made the first time the editor opened the file, not a new game's first save.
  • Restoring replaces the save file on disk at once; the current file is backed up first.
  • Replacing the reference backup overwrites PRISTINE with the file on disk, without unsaved edits.

ui.doctor_game_running: Close Crimson Desert before changing a save.
ui.doctor_done: Repair finished. Start the game to check that it loads.
ui.doctor_loaded: {count} mission records in this save do not follow the game's format. They can crash the game at the title screen. Repair them with File > Save Doctor.
ui.doctor_note: Normal means the save follows every rule this editor knows. It does not promise that the game will load it.
ui.doctor_problem_container: This is not a complete save file, or it could not be read. Restore a backup if one exists.
ui.doctor_problem_integrity: The signature does not match the contents, so the game may refuse this save. Every record still reads, so it can be signed again. A changed value inside a record cannot be detected this way.
ui.doctor_problem_integrity_lost: The signature does not match the contents, and the contents do not read as records. Part of the file is damaged. Restore a backup.
ui.doctor_problem_compression: The contents cannot be decompressed. Part of the file is damaged. Restore a backup.
ui.doctor_problem_schema: The table describing the save cannot be read. Nothing else can be checked. Restore a backup.
ui.doctor_problem_blocks: {count} blocks break the save layout. The original values cannot be worked out from what is left. Restore a backup.
ui.doctor_problem_pointers: A record address points at nothing the save describes. Restore a backup.
ui.doctor_problem_mission_rows: {count} mission records do not follow the game's format. They can crash the game at the title screen, even in a slot you never load. Their values are intact, so they can be rewritten.
ui.doctor_problem_game_version: This save comes from a newer game than this editor was checked against. A newer SaveUltimate may know more.
ui.doctor_problem_game_version_old: Saves from game version 1.x are not supported, so this editor cannot open it.
ui.doctor_problem_items: The items do not fit the rules this editor knows, so it cannot open this save. Restore a backup.
ui.doctor_problem_page: The file structure is fine, but this page could not be read. Sync game data and check again. The save itself may still work in the game.
ui.doctor_problem_enchants: {count} items are enchanted past their limit. If you raised them on purpose, you can leave them.
ui.doctor_problem_sockets: {count} items have more sockets or gems than the game allows. Another editor may have raised them. This editor does not change them here.
ui.doctor_problem_unknown_items: {count} items are missing from the game data this editor has. Sync game data and check again.
